reviews.text:
I highly recommend Dog Walker Wimbledon. Either Lauren or Paul take my dog, Bruno, out for walks twice a week and provide an excellent, reliable service. Bruno is always excited to see them and comes home happy, well exercised, and content after every walk.

It's clear they genuinely care about the dogs they look after, and I have complete confidence that Bruno is in safe and capable hands. Communication is always great, and they are dependable, friendly, and professional.

If you're looking for a trustworthy dog walker in Wimbledon, I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them.

Couldn’t recommend Kevin more highly! Our lab Joey is always happy to see him and has a wonderful stay & great care and attention while we’re away. Very grateful to have Kevin’s services available to us when we need them.
Kevin was excellent with our dog Bruno recently for a brief stay. Thanks so much for looking after him and sharing the photos throughout. Would highly recommend!

Kevin has been absolutely fantastic with my three Yorkies. On the days I’m working long hours, he pops in to check on them, and I honestly couldn’t ask for a better person to trust with them.

He is reliable, kind, and clearly has a natural way with dogs. My Yorkies are always calm, happy, and well looked after when I get home, which says everything. It gives me real peace of mind knowing they’re in such good hands while I’m away.

I would highly recommend Kevin to anyone looking for someone dependable and genuinely caring to look after their pets.

Title: Highly Recommended Dog Walker - The Dogwalker Wimbledon

Kevin from “The Dogwalker Wimbledon” has been walking our 12-year-old Westie, Fluffy, three days a week for a couple of months now, and we couldn't be happier. We were initially worried about how a senior dog would handle a new walker, but the transition has been seamless.
Fluffy absolutely loves his walks and looks forward to them every day. Kevin is punctual, polite, and a great communicator—he responds quickly to messages and sends us regular photo updates, which we love. If you’re looking for a reliable and caring dog walker, we highly recommend Kevin’s services!
Kevin is a fantastic dog walker. Very kind and gentle with the dogs

Kevin has been absolutely wonderful with Molly. He’s been incredibly flexible with my ever-changing diary, which has been such a relief, and it’s clear how much care and attention he gives to the dogs he looks after.

Molly absolutely loves staying with him - she comes back happy, relaxed and clearly well exercised. She gets big walks, lots of affection, and a cosy, calm home environment, which really matters to me.

On top of that, Kevin is just a genuinely lovely, reliable person. I’ve felt completely confident leaving Molly in his care and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend him to anyone looking for a kind, trustworthy dog walker and carer.

Thank you, Kevin - we’re very grateful.

Kevin did an excellent job. His responses were quick, his attitude was amazing, and the service was fantastic. Our dog, Simon, loved staying with the other dogs at Kevin’s. He kept us updated and sent us plenty of photos. We also appreciated the price. It was very reasonable, especially considering that we contacted him only a few days before we needed the service!

Kevin has been such a gentleman, and very caring and kind to our 12 year old beagle. I am very happy with the dog daycare and boarding services, punctual with pick up and drop off, quick respond and frequent updates.  Absolutely 100% satisfied with the received Dog walking/care service.

We were really nervous about sending our dog to a new daycare when the one that she'd been with since she was a puppy closed. But Kevin and Paul have been absolutely amazing with her and she loves going. She always comes back excited and exhausted having had a really lovely day and we feel very safe in the knowledge that she is beautifully looked after!

We’ve had a fantastic experience with the Dog Walker Wimbledon. Communications are managed very well with timely responses. Our Frenchie, Hugo loves his walks with Lauren - he always comes home tired and happy. Would highly recommend these services!
These guys are great! Always there when I've needed them, kind and the dogs really love them. In fact, both dog walkers are practically part of the family now.

Kevin and the team are fantastic! They're accomodating and take extremely good care of my doggo dusty. They are super helpful when I need to make last minute bookings and will go the extra mile to help. Highly recommended❤️🙏 …

Norman has always been anxious around people. This makes it particularly challenging when finding day care. Having had a bad experience elsewhere I was not very optimistic.

From the first meeting with Kevin I was very reassured and he just got it. He’s been very gentle with Norman, waiting for Norman to grow in confidence.

In the first few months Norman has gone from panic when he’s being picked up to walking out the door with his tail up and jumping into the car. There’s still a little bit further to go but it’s been a consistently positive trend. I’m surprised he’s improved this much.

Kevin is very flexible, great with communication and has a great sense of humour.

Norman comes back exhausted each day. From the pictures he looks like he’s had a fun day. It’s great they go from a nice walk in the common before going off to someone’s house - exactly what I was after.

Couldn’t recommend enough.
Excellent dog walkers. Highly recommend. Flexible and great communication. My dog gets so excited to go on his walks and when I’m at work I always know he will be well looked after! Thank you

Maisey our labradoodle gets so excited to see Paul from The Dog Walker she almost breaks down the door to see him. She comes back exhausted. The team love their charges and in three years I couldn’t have asked for a more caring and professional outfit. As pet owners we view our dogs as children and I know with Kevin and his team Maisey couldn’t be in better hands.

Kevin is fantastic - such a nice guy and Ziggy warmed to him immediately. She goes for lovely walks in Wimbledon Common and plays with other dogs which we love. Kevin sends us great updates (and very good photos) of her which is nice to see. She comes back ready to flop but excited to go again when Kevin returns the next day! Highly recommend.
Friendly and caring and utterly reliable. I can wholly recommend them
Kevin and his team are absolutely fabulous. Our Cavalier Pluto loves his walks with Paul and comes back exhausted! Can't recommend them enough.

My partner and I couldn’t recommend Kevin enough - our spaniel Polly has been with Kevin for nearly three years and he is provides an amazing dog walking / daycare service. We receive regular updates on Polly’s activates throughout the day and Kevin is always very responsive on WhatsApp. Kevin is very accommodating when we need to change, amend or add daycare days to our usual schedule.

We honestly couldn’t recommend Kevin enough, thank you so much!

Meg, Will & Polly

We are so happy to have found Kevin and his team! Our dog is always so excited to go with Paul in the morning. And when he comes home in the afternoon he’s clearly had a fun, active day.  Highly recommend this crew - very professional and they really love dogs!
I have recently moved to the area, and Kevin and the team have been fantastic in accommodating my needs and my dog's needs, while we adjusted to our new routine. Highly recommended service!

Highly recommend - Kevin + Paul are trustworthy and reliable. Our miniature dachshund gets collect twice a week for a walk and they have never let us down. Kevin is flexible with holidays as well if we need a week off from the walking service. Thanks Kevin + Paul!
Great service, very responsive, excellent feedback to let us know how Nellie (our miniature Schnoodle) was doing during her first visit. She had a great few days with Kevin! Thanks.
We're so glad to have found Kevin - our sausage dog loves spending time with him and the other dogs he looks after, and he's friendly, reliable and so accommodating.

Kevin and his team are well respected among the dog walkers I trust that use Wimbledon Common.  That reassures me.  As important my dog is kindly met by her walker that day and she trots off really happily (even for the old lady that she is).
Rory went for a walk and sleepover whilst we were away. He came back very happy. It was good to know he was left in safe hands..

Our five month puppy is absolutely loving their day care - to the extent that I think she prefers being with her doggy friends and Kevin than with us! Kevin and Ben are professional and warm and organised but also flexible and accommodating. A great combination! Recommend them highly.

We have recently started using Kevin at The Dog Walker Wimbledon for daycare for our Labrador. We have been so impressed with it and Otta comes home happy every time. Kevin has great communication and always sends updates of the fun she is having. I highly recommend.
We have our dog in for daycare a couple of days a week and she absolutely loves it and always comes back well exercised. Friendly, great communication and flexibility - would 100% recommend!
